item.title: India: Kashmir, Manipur and the Maoist belt: the situation
item.description:
Security forces in Manipur seized a Kuki-Zo camp, arrested 17 suspected militants and confiscated 24 firearms, while also taking control of the Sinai camp. In Kashmir, IGP Sujit Kumar reviewed crime disposal, winter preparedness and policing measures across the valley, and a youth was wounded in a bear attack in South Kashmir. The Kuki-Zo Women’s Forum called for President's Rule in Manipur, framing the crisis as political rather than security related, and Gaurav Gogoi questioned the Centre's response. 437 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.

Machine-written from the linked sources, checked for figures and names not in them.
